title: Boundary edges of the OR function
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $i$ be a coordinate of the sign cube $\\{-1,1\\}^n$, and let $e$ be an edge in direction $i$ whose endpoint has coordinate $i$ equal to $1$. The OR function takes different values at the two endpoints of $e$ if and only if every coordinate of its endpoint is $1$.
hypotheses_covered: Edge in direction $i$ with its specified endpoint having coordinate $i=1$
